In May, the growth of coal, crude petroleum oil and natural gas produced by industrial enterprises above the designated size accelerated, and the production of electricity showed steady growth.

I. Coal, Crude Petroleum Oil and Natural Gas Production and Relevant Information

Crude petroleum oil production grew steadily. In May, 18.47 million tons of crude petroleum oil were produced by industrial enterprises above the designated size, up by 1.8 percent year on year, a growth rate of 0.3 percentage points faster than that of April, with an average daily output of 596,000 tons.

From January to May, 90.28 million tons of crude petroleum oil were produced by industrial enterprises above the designated size, up by 1.3 percent year on year.

The decline in crude petroleum oil processing expanded. In May, 59.11 million tons of crude petroleum oil were processed by industrial enterprises above the designated size, down by 1.8 percent year on year, with the decline expanding by 0.4 percentage points compared to April; the daily processing capacity averaged 1.907 million tons.

From January to May, 299.37 million tons of crude petroleum oil were processed, up by 0.3 percent year on year.
